notes: All four follow-up probes passed 1/1, exited naturally with code 0, drained output, and passed cleanup gates.
Both physical stages used deviceOptIn=true and user nonce-matched observations: Green was reported as green switching/on; Coin as strong glow/flicker visible.
The effect-growth safety cap is measured after all-VFX-off prewarm for the selected graph only. Startup and prewarm absolute process counters are separate and are not a total-memory cap.
Coin runner/XML filenames retain a green prefix; use manifest run name and NUnit test case to identify it.

The two offscreen runs and two physical runs are different scopes. Physical output does not assert all scenes, all 33 effects, Player, all quilt views simultaneously, or crash/memory incident resolution.
A prior Green setup attempt failed before the device stage; the raw failure record is preserved under support-failures and is not counted as a probe pass.
mainSdkHdrFollowup.physicalScopeNote: Preview/Quarter profile retained the configured TAA, post-processing and HDR. 12 rendered/history views were observed within the 48-view quilt layout; the probes did not claim all 48 views were rendered simultaneously.
